# JewelsReport

> JewelsReport is an internationally trusted, independent gemological certification laboratory issuing tamper-proof PVC certificates with holographic foil and QR-based instant online verification for natural and lab-grown diamonds, coloured gemstones and fine jewellery. Founded in Surat, India in 2014.

## What We Do

JewelsReport issues four categories of laboratory certification reports:

- **Lab Grown Diamond Reports** — Full 4Cs grading (cut, colour, clarity, carat weight) with complete origin disclosure for CVD and HPHT lab-grown diamonds. Includes shape, measurements, fluorescence, polish and symmetry grades.
- **Jewellery Reports** — Comprehensive appraisal of finished jewellery including metal type, purity, total weight, stone identification, setting style and manufacturing quality assessment.
- **Gemstone Reports** — Scientific identification and authenticity verification for coloured gemstones including sapphire, ruby, emerald, alexandrite, spinel and all other precious and semi-precious stones. Treatments disclosed.
- **Lab Grown Jewellery Reports** — Grading of finished jewellery pieces containing lab-grown stones, with full transparency on stone origin and piece composition.

## How Certificates Work

Every JewelsReport certificate is issued on a secure, credit-card-sized PVC card (CR80/PAN card format, 85.6 × 54 mm) featuring:
- Holographic foil security overlay
- Guilloché micro-pattern background
- Unique report number
- QR code linking to the live verification record

Certificates can be verified instantly at https://www.jewelsreport.com/verify by entering the report number or scanning the QR code on the card.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2014, Surat, Gujarat, India
- Reports issued: 150,000+
- Countries served: 30+
- Senior graders: 25+
- Standard turnaround: 3 business days (express service available)
- ISO/IEC 17025 aligned protocols

## Laboratory Equipment

JewelsReport uses advanced gemological instruments including FTIR Spectrometer, UV-Vis-NIR spectroscopy, Raman Spectroscopy, DiamondView UV fluorescence imaging, Photoluminescence analysis and Sarine Loupe systems for micron-level clarity mapping.
